About Smart Working

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn t just another remote opportunity - it s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. About the Role

As a Senior Parametric Engineer, you will work on a standalone product within a dedicated product team, collaborating directly with the product lead and in-house specialists. The team operates separately from a new AI/Full-Stack product team for now, although the two teams are expected to connect in future.

The role combines geometry algorithm development, computational optimisation, internal tooling, and cloud/backend development. The precise balance will depend on your skills and interests and may evolve as priorities change. Around 99% of the role is software development on the standalone product, with your work also interacting with its 3D interface.

Responsibilities
  • Develop geometry algorithms.
  • Work on computational optimisation.
  • Build internal tools.
  • Contribute to cloud and backend development.
  • Develop the standalone product, with around 99% of the role focused on C# development.
  • Write code that interacts with the products 3D engine.
  • Collaborate directly with the product lead within the dedicated product team.
  • Collaborate with in-house Unreal specialists on interface work.
  • Work across a broad role scope that may evolve over time, with the balance of responsibilities shaped around your specific skills and interests and changing priorities.
Requirements
  • 5+ years of C# experience at an expert or advanced level. C# is the primary language for the product and there is no substitute for this requirement.
  • 2+ years of AWS experience with working knowledge, or experience with another major cloud provider such as Azure or GCP with willingness to pick up AWS.
  • 3+ years of AEC computational design or geometry experience with a solid understanding. Computational or algorithmic design experience from adjacent domains such as manufacturing, robotics, CAD, simulation or games can be considered as a substitute.
  • 2-3 years of applied computational optimisation experience, or a strong applied mathematics/algorithms background with demonstrated optimisation experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience at mid-to-senior level is suggested, reflecting the depth needed for the core C# development work.
Nice to Have
  • 1-2 years of Unity, Unreal or 3D game engine experience with basic familiarity.
  • Understanding of 3D vector maths, mesh geometry, rendering and shaders, even without direct game engine experience.
  • Unity experience is useful in the short term and Unreal experience in the longer term as the product interface transitions from Unity to Unreal. In-house Unreal specialists lead this work directly, so engine expertise is a bonus rather than a requirement.
Benefits
  • Fixed Shifts: 12:00 PM - 9:30 PM IST (Summer) | 1:00 PM - 10:30 PM IST (Winter)
  • No Weekend Work: Real work-life balance, not just words
  • Day 1 Benefits: Laptop and full medical insurance provided

jobDescription:
Position Overview

Vodafone Idea is looking for a seasoned AI Architect to design, build, and scale enterprise-grade AI and Generative AI (GenAI) solutions. In this role, you will be responsible for defining the technical architecture and roadmap for AI applications deployed on top of our enterprise Cloudera Data Platform (CDP 7.1.9 / 7.3.1).

You will bridge the gap between complex big data ecosystems and cutting-edge machine learning/LLM workflows. The ideal candidate brings hands-on expertise in model selection, lifecycle governance, prompt engineering, and production-grade MLOps/AIOps integrated into modern DevOps pipelines.

Key Responsibilities

1. Enterprise AI & CDP Solution Architecture

  • Lead the end-to-end architecture and integration of Predictive AI and Generative AI applications built directly on CDP 7.1.9 / 7.3.1 infrastructure.
  • Design high-throughput, low-latency data pipelines and feature stores leveraging CDP components (Spark, Hive, Impala, Kafka, Apache Iceberg).
  • Establish retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frameworks, fine-tuning setups, and vector search systems connected to enterprise big data repositories.

2. Model Selection, Implementation & Governance

  • Evaluate, benchmark, and select optimal foundational models (LLMs, SLMs, open-source vs. proprietary) and classic ML algorithms tailored for telecom use cases (e.g., customer churn, network optimization, hyper-personalization, fraud detection).
  • Enforce robust AI Governance frameworks covering model drift detection, explainability (XAI), fairness/bias mitigation, data privacy, and compliance.
  • Manage model registry, lifecycle versioning, and policy enforcement across dynamic runtime environments.

3. Prompt Engineering & GenAI Optimization

  • Establish standardized prompt engineering methodologies, context-window management, and agentic workflows (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen).
  • Optimize token utilization, latency, throughput, and inference costs for LLM deployments.
  • Implement guardrails, output validation, and safety filters to prevent hallucination, data leakage, and security risks in public/private LLM interactions.

4. MLOps, AIOps & DevOps Integration

  • Design and implement robust MLOps/AIOps pipelines for automated model training, continuous integration, testing, deployment, and real-time monitoring (CI/CD/CT).
  • Partner with DevOps teams to deploy containerized AI microservices (Kubernetes, Docker) within hybrid-cloud and on-premises infrastructure.
  • Configure comprehensive telemetry, logging, and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, MLflow, Weights & Biases) to maintain continuous operational health.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Education: Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative field.

jobDescription:
We are looking for an experienced Automation Specialist to lead initiatives that improve end-user computing operations and enhance user experience through intelligent automation.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise in Generative AI (GenAI) and Agentic AI, and a strong background in scripting, infrastructure automation, and workflow orchestration.

• Design and implement agentic AI workflows that autonomously manage provisioning, compliance, and remediation tasks.
• Deploy GenAI-powered virtual agents to support ticket triage, contextual help, and predictive issue resolution.

• Develop PowerShell and Python scripts to automate provisioning, patching, and reporting.
• Use Terraform to define and manage infrastructure-as-code for hybrid and cloud environments.
• Maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and other DevOps tools.
Workflow Orchestration
• Build business process automation using Power Automate and Microsoft 365 tools.
• Integrate platforms such as ServiceNow, Teams, and Intune to streamline workflows and notifications.
Monitoring & Optimization
• Track system performance and user experience metrics.
• Identify automation opportunities and lead continuous improvement initiatives.

Documentation & Enablement
• Create technical documentation, SOPs, and user guides.
• Train IT staff and end users on new tools, workflows, and AI capabilities.

• Experience with GenAI platforms (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, or similar)
• Hands-on knowledge of agentic AI design and orchestration
• Strong scripting skills in PowerShell, Python, and Terraform
• Familiarity with GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices

• OpenAI Developer Certification or equivalent

title: Senior Voice AI Engineer - Convogent Delivery
jobDescription:
AIVAR INNOVATIONS
Senior Voice AI Engineer - Convogent Delivery
3-5 Years | Coimbatore/ Bangalore |Full-Time
About Aivar Innovations
Aivar Innovations is an AI-native services and software company and an AWS Preferred Partner, backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Sorin Investments. We ship production-grade AI into enterprise environments across fintech, healthcare, and technology. Our work is anchored by four accelerator platforms: Convogent (voice and agent AI automation), Velogent (governed agentic process automation for regulated industries), Kubogent (Kubernetes-native AIOps), and Datagent (data and analytics). We measure ourselves by what runs in production, not by slideware.
Role Overview
We are hiring a Senior Voice AI Engineer for Aivars Delivery organization to take voice AI use cases from discovery through live production for our enterprise customers. You will build and customize voice agents on top of Convogent - Aivars voice AI accelerator - working directly within customer engagements, delivery timelines, and SOW commitments. This is a hands-on engineering role embedded in customer-facing delivery pods, partnering closely with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and customer technical stakeholders to ship measurable outcomes on live calls.
What Youll Do
  • Own customer delivery outcomes. Take voice AI use cases from discovery through production go-live within committed timelines, working inside Rocketlane-tracked delivery plans alongside your Delivery Manager.
  • Customize and configure Convogent. Adapt Aivars voice AI accelerator (built on Pipecat, LiveKit) to each customers telephony stack (Twilio, Exotel, Cisco, Vonage, etc.), API/MCP integrations with customer CRM tools, knowledge base (KB) integrations, compliance constraints, and use-case requirements.
  • Engineer real-time audio pipelines for production. Optimize STT and TTS flows for the latency, concurrency, and call quality bar each customer engagement demands.
  • Troubleshoot customer production systems. When a live call does not sound right, quickly narrow down where in the pipeline it broke - capture, STT, orchestration, or TTS - by asking the right questions, reading the right signals, and driving the fix through to resolution.
  • Build and adapt the orchestration layer. Connect STT, TTS, and LLM agents into resilient, observable workflows with guardrails suited to the customers risk and compliance profile.
  • Translate customer requirements into deployable solutions. Work directly with customer technical stakeholders alongside Aivars SA and DM to scope, size, and iterate use cases against measurable outcomes - success rate, latency, adoption.
  • Report and govern delivery. Contribute to sprint tracking, status reporting, and stakeholder governance for the use cases you own.
What Youll Bring
  • Hands-on experience building and deploying voice agents with Pipecat, LiveKit, or similar frameworks - ideally across multiple distinct production deployments, not a single system.
  • Deep expertise in STT (Deepgram, Whisper, AssemblyAI, Google STT, Sarvam) and TTS (ElevenLabs, Cartesia, Amazon Polly).
  • Working knowledge of Speech-to-Speech (S2S) services, including Amazon Nova Sonic, and how they change pipeline and orchestration design compared to cascaded STT/LLM/TTS.
  • Experience with multi-speaker diarization and conversation segmentation.
  • Production fluency in Python plus at least one of Node.js, TypeScript, or Go.
  • Practical use of AI/ML libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn) and conversational AI design - prompt engineering and integration with LLMs (GPT-4o, Claude, Bedrock models).
  • Cloud deployment experience on AWS (Lambda, EC2, S3, EKS, Polly, Transcribe, Bedrock) with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD.
  • Demonstrated ability to work under SOW/contract constraints - scoping, prioritizing, and shipping within a defined timeline and budget across live customer engagements.
  • Comfort working across multiple concurrent customer engagements with differing requirements, tech stacks, and stakeholders.
Preferred Experience
  • Prior experience in a customer delivery, consulting, or systems integration role, rather than purely product/platform engineering.
  • Exposure to regulated industries (fintech, healthcare, BFSI) and their compliance and security constraints.
  • Experience with enterprise stakeholder management - running status calls, translating technical tradeoffs into business language.
  • Familiarity with low-code voice platforms alongside custom infrastructure.
  • Voice analytics, transcription tooling, and Indian-language STT/TTS models.
  • AWS or speech technology certifications.

Why This Role, Why Aivar

  • Work that ships to real customers. Every use case you build runs live on enterprise calls, measured by customer outcomes, not demos.
  • Own delivery end-to-end. From discovery call to production go-live, you are the engineering owner of the customers voice AI outcome.
  • Build on accelerators that work. Convogent has real production traction - you configure and extend a working platform across diverse customer environments.
  • Direct customer exposure. Work face-to-face with enterprise technical stakeholders, not just internal teams.
  • Backed and proven. AI-native, AWS Preferred Partner, BVP- and Sorin-backed, with 100+ enterprise customers in the first year.

Kuku TV is looking for a Mid-Senior Video Editor (2-5 years) who can turn scripts, performances, live-action footage, and AI-generated visuals into high-retention, binge-worthy micro-dramas. This role is ideal for an editor who understands that great short-form storytelling is not just about cutting footage-it s about hooking viewers, building emotion, escalating conflict, and ending every episode with a reason to watch the next one.

Storytelling Editing

  • Apply principles of information control, escalating conflict, pattern interruption, and retention-driven editing.

Mobile-First Storytelling

  • Edit specifically for vertical 9:16 formats and mobile viewing.
  • Maintain strong composition, visual hierarchy, readable performances, and screen impact.

AI Video VFX

  • Handle AI-assisted post-production including lip-sync correction, cleanup, upscaling, frame interpolation, shot extension, masking, tracking, compositing, and background replacement.
  • Know when an AI shot can be fixed in post-production and when it needs to be regenerated.

Visual Sound Finishing

  • Seamlessly integrate live-action and AI footage through colour correction, grading, reframing, compositing, motion treatment, and visual matching.
  • Create titles, captions, transitions, motion graphics, VFX, recaps, end cards, and promotional elements when required.
  • Handle dialogue editing, music, ambience, Foley, and SFX to strengthen emotional and dramatic impact.

Production Collaboration

  • Experience editing dialogue-driven scenes, romance, emotional sequences, action, confrontations, reveals, and cliffhangers.

title: Freelance Software Engineer - AI Coding Agent Evaluation
jobDescription:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.
About the Role
You ll design coding tasks that challenge frontier AI coding agents. Each task is a self-contained Docker environment with a broken piece of software; an AI agent attempts the fix; automated tests verify the outcome. Your deliverable is the full task package: broken code, tests, instructions, and a reference solution proving the task is solvable.
Responsibilities :
  • Invent a realistic developer scenario - a real bug, a broken ETL, a missing feature - not a toy problem.
  • Build a reproducible Docker environment with pinned dependencies.
  • Write a pytest that verifies outcomes, not specific commands - deterministic, non-flaky, and does not leak the fix.
  • Write an instruction.md that reads like a Jira ticket a developer would receive.
  • Write a reference solve.sh proving the task is solvable.
  • Calibrate difficulty so current state-of-the-art agents solve the task 20-60% of the time.
  • Iterate based on feedback from expert QA reviewers.
  • Later: review other authors tasks as a QA reviewer.
Not in scope
  • Data labeling, prompt engineering.
  • Production code to ship - you design problems and verification for AI agents.
  • Leetcode puzzles - scenarios must look like real developer work.
  • Not every candidate task ships - quality over quantity.
Requirements
  • 3+ years of production software development in one backend stack - Python, Go, Node.js, Java, or Rust. Depth in one stack beats breadth.
  • Python + pytest fluency - required regardless of primary stack. The task harness is pytest-based even when the broken app is in another language. Fixtures, parametrize, monkeypatch, timeouts, conftest.py.
  • Docker authoring - reproducible Dockerfiles, pinned dependencies, multi-stage builds when needed, non-root user.
  • Linux Bash - comfort debugging inside containers (strace, lsof, journalctl); shell beyond set -euo pipefail.
  • AI coding agent experience - Claude Code, Cursor, Roo Code, or similar, on non-trivial work. You can cite a specific time the AI was confidently wrong and how you caught it.
  • English - B2+ written.
Not a fit
  • Data Science, ML, or Computer Vision engineers without backend-engineering output.
  • Manual QA testers without automation or test authoring.
  • Frontend-only, low-code / no-code, IT Support, or Business Analysts.
  • Engineers who have never written pytest from scratch.
  • Junior, intern, or assistant as the most recent role.
Preferred qualifications
  • Domain depth in Security, System Administration (nginx / systemd / cron), Scientific Computing (NumPy / PyTorch / SciPy), DevOps, or Git internals.
  • Modern Python tooling (uv, poetry, pyproject.toml).
  • Coverage tooling (pytest-cov, coverage.py, gcov, llvm-cov, kcov).
  • Fuzzing or property-based testing (Hypothesis).
  • Prior contribution to agent-evaluation benchmarks or related frameworks.
Process
Apply Pass qualification (90-minute sample-task screen + short behavioral interview) Join a project Complete tasks Get paid.
Time commitment
  • Onboarding: ~10 hours per first task.
  • Steady state: ~5 hours per task, 2-4 parallel tasks per author.
  • Realistic weekly load: 8-20 hours. Higher volume available for top performers.
  • You choose when and how to contribute; tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet acceptance criteria.
Compensation:
  • Paid contributions, rates up to $35/hour .
  • Task-based compensation equivalent to hourly rate, depending on performance and volume.
  • Some projects include incentive payments.
Rates vary based on expertise, skills assessment, location, project needs, and other factors. Higher rates may be provided to highly specialized experts. Lower rates may apply during onboarding or non-core project phases. Payment details are shared per project.

Submit your CV via the Mindrift platform. Indicate your English level, note this role (Software Engineering Evaluation Specialist - Terminal Bench), and include a GitHub profile link if available.

- Month 1 - all environments live, CI/CD running, the walking skeleton deployed automatically.
- Month 2 - monitoring, alerting and centralised logs in place; backups running with a tested restore.
- Month 3 - the edge gateway image built and running against analyser simulators.

Two-week sprints. Everything is code - infrastructure included. Code review on every pull request.

jobDescription:
Full-Stack Developer (AI-Native)


We are hiring a full-stack developer with strong AI engineering skills to own the applications, tools, and digital products we build in-house, end to end.


This is a hands-on ownership role. You will design and build our own web applications, internal tools and AI features, take them from prototype to production, keep them reliable and secure once live, and turn ideas into working products. You will also work alongside our existing engineers on the larger products we are building.


This is a role for someone who works fluently with AI development tools as a core part of how they operate. We expect you to use AI not just to write code faster, but to read and understand systems quickly, reason about technical decisions, and ship AI features with confidence. You also verify what the tools produce: you test it, probe it, and can explain what they got wrong and how you caught it. That fluency is central to the role.


This is a fully remote opportunity, operating in UK timezone.


Working: 5.5 days per week. Monday - Friday: 9am - 6pm UK time. Saturday: 9am - 1:30pm UK time.


The Role


You will:


* Design, build, and ship our own web applications, tools, and digital products end to end, across the full stack (React / Next.js front end, plus Node / TypeScript APIs, PostgreSQL, integrations, and auth).

* Build AI features into real products: LLM integrations, RAG, agents and structured outputs, with validation, fallbacks and evaluation so they hold up in production, not just in a demo.

* Own the back end and data layer of what you build: schema design, migrations, transactions, background jobs, webhooks, and third-party integrations (payments, messaging, email).

* Keep what we ship healthy once it is live: performance, reliability, security, uptime, monitoring, and fixes.

* Read, review and harden code you did not write, including code produced with AI tools, before it reaches production.

* Build high-quality, responsive front ends when the feature needs it, to a solid standard of polish, performance, and accessibility.

* Deploy and run what you build (Vercel, Google Cloud Run, Docker, CI/CD) and keep environments, secrets and pipelines tidy.

* Use AI development tools fluently throughout your work, to build, to understand unfamiliar code quickly, and to move fast without losing rigour.

* Turn early ideas into working prototypes fast, and take the ones that work through to production.


What we're looking for


* 3+ years building full-stack web applications, with a portfolio of live work you can speak to in depth.

* Strong, current full-stack skills: TypeScript, Node.js, React, Next.js, PostgreSQL, APIs, auth, and integrations, with real back-end and data depth.

* Hands-on experience building and running AI features in production: LLM APIs, RAG, agents, prompt and output validation, evaluation, and the failure modes that come with them.

* A solid grasp of what goes wrong in real systems: authorisation on every data path, input validation, idempotency, concurrency, secrets, and logging.

* Demonstrable, fluent use of AI coding tools as part of your daily workflow, including using them to read and understand unfamiliar codebases quickly, and to check their own output.

* Clear communication and the confidence to explain technical decisions and trade-offs clearly, in writing and in conversation, to technical and non-technical people.

* Comfort working independently in a remote, UK-timezone team and owning delivery end to end.


Nice to have: payments and webhooks in production (Razorpay, Stripe); background jobs and queues (Inngest, BullMQ); vector search and evaluation tooling; Postgres at depth (Prisma, Drizzle); Docker, Cloud Run, Vercel; design-tool familiarity (Figma); analytics tooling (GA4, GTM)

* Use Grok as the primary AI video-generation platform.

* Add and synchronize dialogue, music, sound effects, captions, and other required audio.

* Identify and correct visual artifacts, continuity errors, lip-sync issues, and deviations from the script.

* Maintain organized prompt logs, character references, shot lists, source files, and project versions.

* Deliver finished videos in the required aspect ratios and platform-ready formats.


Requirements


* Strong experience creating AI-generated video, preferably using Grok.

* Proficiency with any professional video-editing software of your choice.

* Exceptional attention to detail and ability to follow instructions precisely.

* Strong understanding of shot composition, pacing, continuity, and visual storytelling.

jobDescription:
About the Role


We believe great user experiences begin with understanding business problems before designing solutions. We are looking for a proactive, analytical professional who enjoys engaging with diverse stakeholder groups, simplifying complexity and translating ideas into practical, user-centred digital solutions.

As part of our Product & Business Experience practice, you will independently own UX solutioning activities across assigned client engagements with minimal supervision. Our work spans enterprise applications, corporate websites, digital platforms, data portals and product initiatives, requiring the ability to adapt to diverse business domains and project types. You will lead discovery, facilitate stakeholder discussions, define solution direction, guide visual designers and collaborate closely with engineering teams to deliver solutions that balance business goals, user needs and technical feasibility.

AI is an integral part of how we work. We expect leads to actively leverage AI for research, ideation, conceptualisation, solution exploration, documentation, wireframing, prototyping and delivery, while continuously evaluating emerging AI capabilities.


Key Responsibilities


Business Discovery & Solutioning

  • Independently lead discovery workshops to understand business objectives, user needs and operational challenges.
  • Bring together diverse stakeholder groups to build a shared understanding of business problems and solution direction.
  • Analyse business processes and translate discussions into clear requirements, decisions and actionable next steps.
  • Help establish realistic scope and priorities while balancing business goals, user experience and engineering feasibility.

Experience Design

  • Translate business problems into intuitive digital experiences across a variety of project types.
  • Define experience direction through user journeys, workflows, information architecture, conceptual wireframes and interactive prototypes.
  • Provide functional guidance to visual designers while preserving business intent, usability and technical feasibility.

Stakeholder Facilitation

  • Confidently engage business users, SMEs, engineering teams, project managers and leadership.
  • Facilitate discussions, build consensus and constructively challenge assumptions where appropriate.
  • Own the UX solutioning workstream for assigned projects while collaborating with practice leadership on larger strategic initiatives.

Delivery Excellence

  • Support engineering teams during implementation to ensure the intended experience is realised.
  • Contribute reusable UX assets, templates and design patterns, and actively share project learnings to strengthen the practice.
  • Continuously improve delivery quality through structured thinking and knowledge sharing.

AI-Enabled Ways of Working

  • Use AI daily for research, ideation, conceptualisation, documentation, wireframing, prototyping and productivity.
  • Stay current with emerging AI capabilities, including agentic workflows where appropriate, and evaluate how they can improve delivery.

What We're Looking For

  • 48 years of experience delivering UX solutions for enterprise applications, websites, portals, digital products or similar digital initiatives.
  • Strong business analysis, solutioning and structured problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to independently own assigned projects while recognising when to seek guidance.
  • Proven ability to engage, influence and build consensus across multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Ability to balance business goals, user needs and engineering feasibility.
  • Strong communication, facilitation and presentation skills.
  • Working knowledge of Figma or similar tools for conceptualisation and wireframing.
  • Good appreciation of visual design with the ability to guide visual designers.
  • Comfortable using AI as a core part of everyday work and keen to adopt emerging AI capabilities.
  • Proactive, self-motivated and committed to continuous learning.

Purpose of the role:

To own MetisEI's AI agent layer end-to-end. We are rolling out approximately 30 agents spanning production, supply chain, quality, HR and finance. Several are already live at CT Mexico. These agents send reports and instructions directly to line managers and plant staff, largely over WhatsApp so reliability is the job, not a nice-to-have.


Key responsibilities:

  • Design, build and maintain the agent layer production efficiency reporting, workforce and absence reporting, supply chain, quality and finance agents.
  • Enforce the deterministic/LLM boundary. All arithmetic, thresholds, bucketing, ranking and fixed content must be computed and validated in code. The LLM is used for natural language rewriting of a pre-verified output only.
  • Build and maintain automated test suites and evaluation harnesses for every agent. Agents must be regression-tested before any prompt or logic change reaches a live recipient.
  • Build output validation that blocks a message from sending if it fails its rules, rather than relying on the model to comply.
  • Configure and operate the WhatsApp Business Platform (Meta Cloud API) business account and number setup, message template submission and approval, webhook handling, delivery and read receipts, error and retry handling, opt-in management, rate limits and quality rating.
  • Build scheduled delivery pipelines (daily and weekly cadences, timezone-correct per site) including PDF report generation and attachment.
  • Work directly with plant management and HR to specify agent behaviour, then translate that into testable rules.
  • Maintain a versioned content library (tips, templates, standard messaging) with verbatim-copy guarantees where required.

Essential requirements:

  • Strong Python. This role writes real software, not just prompts.
  • Hands-on production experience with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI or equivalent) not experimental or personal-project only.
  • Demonstrable experience building evaluation and testing frameworks for non-deterministic systems.
  • Practical understanding of where LLMs fail and how to constrain them structured output, validation, guardrails, fallbacks.
  • WhatsApp Business Platform / Meta Cloud API configuration experience, or equivalent messaging platform integration (Twilio, SMS gateways) with clear ability to pick up WhatsApp specifics.
  • Webhook and asynchronous job/scheduling experience.
  • Ability to work with non-technical stakeholders and convert loose requirements into precise, testable rules.

Desirable:

  • PDF and report generation.
  • Retrieval-augmented generation and vector databases (Qdrant).
  • Manufacturing or operations domain exposure.
  • Spanish.

title: Systems Administrator, Billing Systems
jobDescription:
Systems Administrator, Billing Systems

About the Role

Billing infrastructure is revenue infrastructure. In a business running an enterprise sales-led motion and a product-led self-serve motion in parallel, the configuration quality of that stack directly determines what Finance can close cleanly, what customers are billed accurately, and how much revenue is recovered when payments fail. Were hiring a systems administrator who treats it that way.

We are seeking a Systems Administrator, Billing Systems to serve as the senior platform expert across our billing stack and a trusted operational partner to Finance, RevOps, and Product Engineering. This role will own day-to-day administration of and production support across the billing systems landscape in a scaled, dual-motion SaaS environment.

What You Will Do

Billing Systems Administration

  • Own multiple billing platform administration for both our PLG self-serve motion and enterprise-grade invoicing and billing, including: payment methods, product and pricing catalog, subscription lifecycle, webhook monitoring, and dispute handling
  • Maintain pricing configurations, billing templates, and subscription structures as directed by Finance and RevOps. When the price book changes, Billing Systems reflects it cleanly
  • Own dunning and revenue recovery configuration: retry schedules, smart retry settings, grace period logic, and dunning email sequences. Monitor recovery rates and optimize the sequence over time
  • Monitor platform health proactively. Identify processing failures, data integrity issues, and configuration gaps before they surface in Finance reporting or customer invoices
  • Serve as the primary Stripe and BillingPlatform platform contact for Finance, RevOps, and the billing engineering team
  • Execute configuration changes following change management controls: documented, tested, and deployed cleanly

Quote-to-Cash Integrations

  • Maintain the integration between Selling/Quoting systems and Billing Systems so quote-to-cash data flows are intact and deals land correctly in relevant billing systems
  • Support CPQ-related billing configurations in partnership with the CPQ Lead: price book alignment, quote output formats, and contract-to-subscription linkages
  • Configure and test PLG self-serve billing flows for new product launches, pricing changes, free trial conversion logic, and self-serve subscription management

Provisioning Connectivity

  • Partner with Product Engineering on the billing-to-provisioning handoff across both PLG self-serve and SLG enterprise motions.
  • Maintain the billing-side integration touchpoints that connect Stripe and BillingPlatform to provisioning workflows, ensuring subscription and order events carry the right data for downstream customer access
  • Monitor the billing-to-provisioning handoff and escalate with context when subscription or order events fail to propagate cleanly into customer access
  • Support provisioning impact assessment when pricing, packaging, or tier structures change on the billing side

Data Quality & Reconciliation

  • Run regular data quality checks across billing systems: subscriber data, payment records, invoice history, and subscription states across SLG and PLG customers
  • Support billing reconciliation across BillingPlatform, Stripe, Avalara, and NetSuite
  • Support month-end and quarter-end close with clean, complete, defensible data for Finance reporting
  • Maintain runbooks and escalation documentation for common billing data issues

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in billing systems administration, revenue operations, or SaaS billing in environments serving both enterprise and self-serve customers
  • Deep hands-on experience with Stripe: subscription management, payment processing, webhook configuration, dunning configuration, and PLG billing flows
  • Hands-on experience with an enterprise subscription billing platform such as BillingPlatform, Revenue Cloud, Zuora, or Chargebee
  • Development skills in building automation workflows in billing systems via API, webhooks, and other workflow configurations
  • Familiarity with Salesforce CPQ: quote-to-cash process, price book structure, and integration touchpoints with billing systems
  • Familiarity with billing-to-provisioning integration patterns and partnership with product engineering teams on subscription event propagation
  • Experience supporting billing reconciliation with Finance through NetSuite or equivalent ERP
  • Experience in B2B SaaS environments with both sales-led and product-led revenue motions

Preferred

  • Stripe certification such as Stripe Associate
  • Experience with usage-based pricing models, including metered billing, freemium conversion, and monthly self-serve
  • Salesforce CPQ Specialist certification or hands-on CPQ experience

How We Think About AI
At Quickbase, we view AI as a tool to accelerate how work gets done not replace it. We encourage thoughtful use of AI to improve speed, quality, and decision-making, while maintaining strong judgment, accountability, and data integrity.

title: Custom Software Engineer
jobDescription:
Project Role :Custom Software Engineer


Project Role Description :Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.
Must have skills :SAP PP Production Planning Control Discrete Industries

Good to have skills :NA
Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification :15 years full time education

Summary
You will design, configure, and enhance SAP Production Planning (PP) processes for discrete manufacturing environments while using AI assisted development tools and copilots to accelerate requirement analysis, configuration, testing, documentation, and issue resolution. The role focuses on delivering efficient production planning, shop floor execution, and material staging processes while integrating pre built AI services where beneficial. No deep AI model engineering, vector DB work, RAG, or agentic system development is required.


Key Responsibilities
Functional Technical Delivery
Configure and support SAP PP processes including:
oMaterial Requirement Planning (MRP)
oProduction Orders Execution
oRoutings, Work Centers BOM Management
oCapacity Planning Scheduling
oBackflushing Costing Integration
oGoods Movements Shop floor Reporting
Use AI copilots to accelerate:
oFunctional specification creation
oRouting/BOM validation
oTest case generation for MRP, order creation, confirmations
oDocumentation automation (FS/TS/SOPs)
Support full lifecycle delivery:requirements, design, configuration, SIT/UAT, deployment, hypercare support.
Integrate PP with MM, QM, SD, FI/CO, and shop floor systems (MES), leveraging standard APIs and middleware.
AI Assisted Productivity
Use AI copilots for:
oAutomated summarization of requirements and change impacts
oAnalysis of MRP exceptions and planning alerts
oValidation of order execution and production variances
oFaster defect isolation in BOM/routing/work center configurations
Integrate pre built AI services into production workflows, such as:
oPredictive insights (e.g., potential material shortages or order delays)
oIntelligent classification of production issues
oAutomated summarization of production batch deviations
oSmart suggestions based on historical production performance
Use LLM assisted troubleshooting to reduce time spent analyzing MRP exception messages, order failures, and material shortages.
Governance, Quality Collaboration
Ensure compliance with production governance, change controls, data accuracy standards, and audit policies.
Participate in workshops, solution reviews, and process optimization discussions enhanced by AI generated insights.
Collaborate with production, quality, warehouse, procurement, cost controlling, and integration teams to deliver end to end planning excellence.
Create reusable templates, checklists, test packs, and AI enabled best practices for SAP PP delivery.

Required Skills Experience
SAP PP Expertise
Strong understanding of discrete manufacturing processes including BOM/routing management, production order cycles, capacity planning, scheduling, and MRP.
Experience with integration across MM (material availability), QM (inspection lots), SD (demand), and FI/CO (costing).
Familiarity with order confirmations, settlements, and shop floor data capture processes.
AI Ready Skills
Ability to use AI copilots, automated documentation tools, and AI assisted test accelerators.
Comfortable embedding pre built AI capabilities into production planning or execution (not custom model building).
Awareness of responsible AI usage and limitations in manufacturing and planning environments.
General Professional Skills
Strong analytical and problem solving skills related to production variability, MRP outcomes, and resource planning.
Ability to translate manufacturing requirements into scalable SAP PP configurations.
Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and operational teams.
Continuous learning mindset with comfort adopting AI assisted workflows.

Good to Have
SAP PP Certification (S/4HANA Manufacturing).
Experience with MES systems, shop floor integrations, or IoT enabled production data.
Exposure to EWM/WM, PM, or APO/IBP environments.
Familiarity with automated testing tools (Tricentis, CBTA).

Outcome Expectations
Deliver faster, more reliable SAP PP solutions using AI enabled productivity tools.
Improve planning accuracy, resource utilization, and production stability.
Act as a bridge between manufacturing teams, SAP engineering teams, and AI native experts when deeper AI capabilities are required.


Additional Information
A 15 years full time education is required.
Qualification15 years full time education
